data.comment: Main window, status bar: label shown while a database transaction is open.

data.name: Shell_InTransactionTip
data.value: 事务已打开。语句将在其中运行，直到你提交或回滚。
data.comment: Main window, status bar: tooltip of the In transaction label.

data.name: Shell_StagedTip
data.value: 安全模式：这些更改已在本地暂存，尚未写入数据库
data.comment: Main window, status bar: tooltip of the staged-changes segment. Safe mode is a setting that holds edits back for review.

data.name: Shell_ReviewStaged
data.comment: Main window, status bar: button that opens a dialog showing the SQL of the staged changes.

data.name: Shell_ReviewStagedTip
data.value: 显示生成的 SQL，然后将全部更改作为一个事务提交
data.comment: Main window, status bar: tooltip of the Review button for staged changes.

data.name: Shell_DiscardStagedTip
data.value: 放弃所有暂存的更改并从服务器重新加载
data.comment: Main window, status bar: tooltip of the Discard button for staged changes.

data.name: Shell_FixRerun
data.comment: Main window, status bar: button offered after a statement failed on unquoted identifiers; rewrites them quoted and runs again.

data.name: Shell_FixRerunTip
data.value: 将未加引号的标识符改写为与数据库一致，然后再次运行
data.comment: Main window, status bar: tooltip of the Fix & re-run button.

data.name: Shell_ResultsReadOnlyTip
data.comment: Main window, status bar: tooltip of the read-only tag beside the results. {reason} is a sentence fragment starting in lowercase that says why the result cannot be edited, such as "this result is not mapped to one table."

data.name: Shell_FilterBarPinTip
data.comment: Main window, status bar: tooltip and accessible name of the funnel toggle that keeps the filter bar above a browsed table visible. The shortcut is appended by the app.

data.name: Shell_PreviousPage
data.comment: Main window, status bar: tooltip of the arrow button that shows the previous page of a browsed table.

data.name: Shell_NextPage
data.comment: Main window, status bar: tooltip of the arrow button that shows the next page of a browsed table.

data.name: Shell_RowDetailsTip
data.value: 行详情：以表单形式显示所选行
data.comment: Main window, status bar: tooltip of the button that opens the selected row as a form. The shortcut is appended by the app.

data.name: Shell_RowDetails
data.comment: Main window, status bar: accessible name (read by screen readers) of the button that opens row details.

data.name: Shell_PalettePlaceholder
data.value: 跳转到表、已保存的查询或操作…
data.comment: Command palette: placeholder text of the search box.

data.name: Shell_PaletteNoMatches
data.comment: Command palette: text in the middle of the empty list when nothing matches what was typed.

data.name: Shell_ShortcutsTitle
data.comment: Title of the overlay panel that lists the keyboard shortcuts.

data.name: Shell_SettingsTitle
data.comment: Title of the overlay panel that holds the Settings page.

data.name: Shell_AboutTitle
data.comment: Title of the overlay panel that holds the About box.

data.name: Shell_FindDatabase
data.comment: Database list popup (click the database name in the title bar): placeholder text of the search box.

data.name: Shell_ReadingDatabases
data.comment: Database list popup: shown while the list of databases is being read from the server.

data.name: Shell_OpenInNewWindow
data.comment: Right-click menu of a database in the database list popup: opens that database in an additional window.

data.name: Shell_DatabaseListFailed
data.comment: Database list popup: shown when reading the list failed. {error} is the error text from the server or network, such as "connection refused".

data.name: Shell_NoDatabaseAllowed
data.value: 此角色没有可连接的数据库。
data.comment: Database list popup: shown when the list is empty because the current role may not connect to any database.

data.name: Shell_NoDatabaseMatches
data.comment: Database list popup: shown when nothing in the list matches the text typed in the search box.

data.name: Shell_SearchToggleReplace
data.comment: Find bar of the SQL editor (also of the cell inspector), top right of the editor: tooltip of the arrow button that shows or hides the replace row.

data.name: Shell_SearchFind
data.comment: Find bar of the SQL editor (also of the cell inspector), top right of the editor: placeholder text of the search box.

data.name: Shell_SearchMatchCase
data.comment: Find bar of the SQL editor (also of the cell inspector), top right of the editor: tooltip of the "Aa" toggle: when on, upper and lower case letters are different.

data.name: Shell_SearchWholeWords
data.comment: Find bar of the SQL editor (also of the cell inspector), top right of the editor: tooltip of the toggle that matches only whole words.

data.name: Shell_SearchRegex
data.comment: Find bar of the SQL editor (also of the cell inspector), top right of the editor: tooltip of the ".*" toggle that treats the search text as a regular expression.

data.name: Shell_SearchPreviousMatch
data.comment: Find bar of the SQL editor (also of the cell inspector), top right of the editor: tooltip of the up-arrow button. The shortcut is appended by the app.

data.name: Shell_SearchNextMatch
data.comment: Find bar of the SQL editor (also of the cell inspector), top right of the editor: tooltip of the down-arrow button. The shortcut is appended by the app.

data.name: Shell_SearchReplace
data.comment: Find bar of the SQL editor (also of the cell inspector), top right of the editor: placeholder text of the replace box.

data.name: Shell_SearchReplaceNext
data.comment: Find bar of the SQL editor (also of the cell inspector), top right of the editor: tooltip of the button that replaces the current match.

data.name: Shell_SearchReplaceAll
data.comment: Find bar of the SQL editor (also of the cell inspector), top right of the editor: tooltip of the button that replaces every match.

data.name: Shell_MacHide
data.comment: macOS app menu (the menu named after the app, in the menu bar): item that hides the app. {appName} is the product name, pgNimbus.

data.name: Shell_MacHideOthers
data.comment: macOS app menu (the menu named after the app, in the menu bar): item that hides every other application.

data.name: Shell_MacShowAll
data.comment: macOS app menu (the menu named after the app, in the menu bar): item that shows all hidden applications again.

data.name: Shell_MacQuit
data.comment: macOS app menu (the menu named after the app, in the menu bar): item that quits the app. {appName} is the product name, pgNimbus.

data.name: Shell_MacServices
data.comment: macOS app menu (the menu named after the app, in the menu bar): submenu of the operating system's services.

data.name: Shell_MenuUndo
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Edit menu: item that undoes the last edit in the focused text field.

data.name: Shell_MenuRedo
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Edit menu: item that redoes an undone edit in the focused text field.

data.name: Shell_MenuCut
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Edit menu: item that cuts the selected text to the clipboard.

data.name: Shell_MenuPaste
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Edit menu: item that pastes the clipboard text.

data.name: Shell_MenuSelectAll
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Edit menu: item that selects all text in the focused text field.

data.name: Shell_MenuFind
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Edit menu: item that opens the find bar of the SQL editor.

data.name: Shell_ThemeSystem
data.comment: macOS menu bar, View, Appearance submenu: radio item that makes the app follow the operating system's light or dark setting.

data.name: Shell_ThemeLight
data.comment: macOS menu bar, View, Appearance submenu: radio item that selects the light theme.

data.name: Shell_ThemeDark
data.comment: macOS menu bar, View, Appearance submenu: radio item that selects the dark theme.

data.name: Shell_MenuMinimize
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Window menu: item that minimizes the window to the Dock.

data.name: Shell_MenuZoom
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Window menu: item that maximizes the window or returns it to its previous size.

data.name: Shell_MenuBringAllToFront
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Window menu: item that raises every window of the app.

data.name: Shell_MenuFile
data.comment: macOS menu bar: title of the File menu.

data.name: Shell_MenuEdit
data.comment: macOS menu bar: title of the Edit menu (undo, copy, paste).

data.name: Shell_MenuQuery
data.comment: macOS menu bar: title of the Query menu (run, explain, transactions, monitors).

data.name: Shell_MenuView
data.comment: macOS menu bar: title of the View menu (palette, sidebar, appearance).

data.name: Shell_MenuWindow
data.comment: macOS menu bar: title of the Window menu (minimize, tabs, window list).

data.name: Shell_MenuRun
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Query menu: item that runs the SQL of the current tab or the selection.

data.name: Shell_MenuCancel
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Query menu: item that stops the running query.

data.name: Shell_MenuExplain
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Query menu: item that shows the estimated query plan.

data.name: Shell_MenuExplainAnalyze
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Query menu: item that runs the query and shows the measured plan.

data.name: Shell_MenuFormatSql
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Query menu: item that reformats the SQL in the editor.

data.name: Shell_MenuExpandStar
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Query menu: item that replaces SELECT * with the list of column names. Keep SELECT * as it is: it is SQL.

data.name: Shell_MenuBeginTransaction
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Query menu: item that starts a database transaction.

data.name: Shell_MenuCommitTransaction
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Query menu: item that ends the open transaction and keeps its changes.

data.name: Shell_MenuRollbackTransaction
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Query menu: item that ends the open transaction and undoes its changes.

data.name: Shell_MenuRefreshSchema
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Query menu: item that reloads the schema tree from the server.

data.name: Shell_MenuServerActivity
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Query menu: item that opens the Server Activity window.

data.name: Shell_MenuDatabaseOverview
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Query menu: item that opens the Database Overview window.

data.name: Shell_MenuSlowQueries
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Query menu: item that opens the Slow Queries window.

data.name: Shell_MenuQueryLab
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Query menu: item that opens Query Lab, where saved query plans are compared.

data.name: Shell_MenuNotifyMonitor
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Query menu: item that opens the window that watches PostgreSQL LISTEN / NOTIFY messages. LISTEN and NOTIFY are SQL commands.

data.name: Shell_MenuRolesPermissions
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Query menu: item that opens the Roles & Permissions window.

data.name: Shell_MenuCommandPalette
data.comment: macOS menu bar, View menu: item that opens the command palette.

data.name: Shell_MenuHideSidebar
data.comment: macOS menu bar, View menu: item that hides the left sidebar. Shown while the sidebar is visible.

data.name: Shell_MenuShowSidebar
data.comment: macOS menu bar, View menu: item that shows the left sidebar. Shown while the sidebar is hidden.

data.name: Shell_MenuAppearance
data.comment: macOS menu bar, View menu: item that opens the submenu with the System, Light and Dark themes.

data.name: Shell_MenuPreviousTab
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Window menu: item that switches to the query tab on the left.

data.name: Shell_MenuNextTab
data.comment: macOS menu bar, Window menu: item that switches to the query tab on the right.

data.name: Shell_TabMenuSaveQuery
data.comment: Right-click menu of a query tab: saves the tab to the Saved Queries list. A name dialog follows.

data.name: Shell_TabMenuRename
data.comment: Right-click menu of a query tab: renames the tab in place.

data.name: Shell_TabMenuCloseOthers
data.comment: Right-click menu of a query tab: closes every other tab.

data.name: Shell_TabMenuCloseToTheRight
data.comment: Right-click menu of a query tab: closes all tabs to the right of this one.

data.name: Shell_AllowWritesConfirm
data.value: 允许在此窗口中写入生产环境（{connection}）？在你关闭写入或关闭窗口之前，你运行的语句、网格编辑、导入和模式操作都可能更改数据。其他窗口仍保持禁止写入。
data.comment: Confirmation dialog of the production switch in the title bar. {connection} is the connection and database, such as "prod-eu › shop". Writes are changes to data.

data.name: Shell_AllowWritesButton
data.comment: Confirmation dialog of the production switch: the red button that allows writes in this window.

data.name: Shell_ThisConnection
data.comment: Confirmation dialog of the production switch: used in place of the connection name when there is none, so it reads "Allow writes to production (this connection) in this window?".

data.name: Shell_RenameDialogTitle
data.comment: Title of the dialog that asks for a new name of a table or view (from its Maintenance menu). pgNimbus is the product name.

data.name: Shell_SwitchConnectionConfirm
data.value: 切换连接？新连接打开后，此窗口将关闭。{losses}
data.comment: Confirmation dialog of Switch Connection. {losses} is one or two sentences saying what closing the window would lose, such as "2 staged changes will be discarded."

data.name: Shell_SwitchConnectionButton
data.comment: Confirmation dialog of Switch Connection: the button that continues.

data.name: Shell_SavePlanHeading
data.value: 将计划保存到 Query Lab
data.comment: Heading of the dialog that names a query plan to save in Query Lab.

data.name: Shell_SavePlanTitle
data.comment: Window title of the dialog that names a query plan to save in Query Lab. pgNimbus is the product name.

data.name: Shell_PlanNotSaved
data.comment: Status line (bottom of the window): a plan could not be saved to Query Lab.

data.name: Shell_PlanSaved
data.value: 已将计划“{name}”保存到 Query Lab
data.comment: Status line (bottom of the window): a query plan was saved in Query Lab. {name} is the name the user gave it.

data.name: Shell_CloseRestoreRunning
data.value: 还原仍在运行，关闭此窗口会中断它的连接。停止还原并关闭？还原作为一个事务运行，因此它已做的一切都不会保留。
data.comment: Confirmation when closing a window while a restore (pg_restore) runs.

data.name: Shell_CloseRestoreRunningLosses
data.value: 还原仍在运行，关闭此窗口会中断它的连接。停止还原并关闭？还原作为一个事务运行，因此它已做的一切都不会保留。{losses}
data.comment: Confirmation when closing a window while a restore (pg_restore) runs and the window has more to lose. {losses} is one or two sentences, such as "2 staged changes will be discarded."

data.name: Shell_CloseBackupRunning
data.value: 备份仍在运行，关闭此窗口会中断它的连接。停止备份并关闭？
data.comment: Confirmation when closing a window while a backup (pg_dump) runs.

data.name: Shell_CloseBackupRunningLosses
data.value: 备份仍在运行，关闭此窗口会中断它的连接。停止备份并关闭？{losses}
data.comment: Confirmation when closing a window while a backup (pg_dump) runs and the window has more to lose. {losses} is one or two sentences, such as "2 staged changes will be discarded."

data.name: Shell_CloseWindowQuestion
data.comment: Confirmation when closing a window that would lose work. {losses} is one or two sentences, such as "2 staged changes will be discarded."

data.name: Shell_StopRestore
data.comment: Confirmation when closing a window during a restore: the red button that stops the restore and closes.

data.name: Shell_StopBackup
data.comment: Confirmation when closing a window during a backup: the red button that stops the backup and closes.

data.name: Shell_CloseWindowButton
data.comment: Confirmation when closing a window that would lose work: the red button that closes it.

data.name: Shell_StagedSummary_other
data.comment: Title line of the dialog that reviews staged changes (safe mode). Plural. {count} is how many changes, such as 3; {table} the table, such as public.orders.

data.name: Shell_DiscardStagedConfirm_other
data.value: 放弃 {count} 项暂存的更改？数据库不会受到任何影响。
data.comment: Confirmation of the status bar Discard button. Plural. {count} is how many staged changes, such as 3.

data.name: Shell_OpenSqlFileTitle
data.comment: Title of the system file picker that opens a .sql file.

data.name: Shell_SaveSqlFileTitle
data.comment: Title of the system file picker that saves a .sql file.

data.name: Shell_AllFiles
data.comment: File picker: name of the file type filter that shows every file.

data.name: Shell_CantOpenNonLocal
data.comment: Status line: the chosen file is not on this computer (for example a cloud location) and cannot be opened.

data.name: Shell_OpenFailed
data.comment: Status line: a .sql file could not be read. {error} is the system error text, such as "Access to the path is denied."

data.name: Shell_FileNotFound
data.comment: Status line: a recent file no longer exists. {path} is its full path.

data.name: Shell_CantSaveNonLocal
data.value: 无法保存到非本地文件
data.comment: Status line: the chosen location is not on this computer and cannot be written.

data.name: Shell_SavedFile
data.comment: Status line: a .sql file was written. {file} is the file name, such as report.sql.

data.name: Shell_SaveFailed
data.comment: Status line: a .sql file could not be written. {error} is the system error text.

data.name: Shell_NothingToSave
data.value: 没有可保存的内容：此标签页为空
data.comment: Status line: Save was used on a tab with no text.

data.name: Shell_SavedQuery
data.comment: Status line: the tab was saved in the Saved Queries list. {name} is the name of the saved query.

data.name: Shell_SaveAsNewQueryHeading
data.comment: Heading of the dialog that names a new saved query (Save As).

data.name: Shell_SaveQueryHeading
data.comment: Heading of the dialog that names a saved query.

data.name: Shell_FiltersNeedBrowse
data.value: 筛选适用于浏览表时：请在侧边栏中双击一个表。你编写的查询不会被改写；请直接在其中添加 WHERE。
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: shown when the filter command is used outside a browsed table. WHERE is the SQL keyword.

data.name: Shell_AutoAliasOn
data.value: 表自动别名：已开启（orders → orders o）
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: auto-alias was switched on. The example shows what it does to SQL: the table name orders gets the alias o.

data.name: Shell_AutoAliasOff
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: auto-alias was switched off.

data.name: Shell_SafeModeOn
data.value: 安全模式：已开启，网格中的编辑、删除和插入都会暂存以待审阅
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: safe mode was switched on. Safe mode holds changes back for review before they reach the database.

data.name: Shell_SafeModeOff
data.value: 安全模式：已关闭，网格更改会立即生效
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: safe mode was switched off.

data.name: Shell_NoPlanOnScreen
data.value: 屏幕上没有计划：请先运行“解释”或“解释并分析”，或导入一个计划
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: a plan command (save or compare) was used while no query plan is shown.

data.name: Shell_CantSwitchDatabase
data.value: 此窗口无法切换数据库：它没有可用来打开其他数据库的连接配置。
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: the Switch database command was used in a window that has no saved connection profile.

data.name: Shell_SwitchDatabaseConfirm
data.comment: Confirmation dialog when switching database. {database} is the database name; {losses} is one or two sentences saying what closing the current connection would lose, such as "2 staged changes will be discarded."

data.name: Shell_SwitchDatabaseButton
data.comment: Confirmation dialog when switching database: the button that continues.

data.name: Shell_StayedOn
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: the database switch was declined. {database} is the current database.

data.name: Shell_ConnectingTo
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: a connection to another database is being opened. {database} is its name.

data.name: Shell_OpenDatabaseFailed
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: connecting to another database failed. {database} is its name; {error} is the error text, such as "permission denied for database".

data.name: Shell_LossStaged_other
data.value: {count} 项暂存的更改将被放弃
data.comment: One item in the list of what closing a connection loses. Plural. {count} is how many changes staged in safe mode, such as 3.

data.name: Shell_LossTransaction
data.comment: One item in the list of what closing a connection loses (joined into a sentence by the app). A sentence fragment starting in lowercase.

data.name: Shell_LossRunning_other
data.value: {count} 个正在运行的查询将被取消
data.comment: One item in the list of what closing a connection loses. Plural. {count} is how many queries are running, such as 2.

data.name: Shell_LossesTwo
data.comment: Joins two items of the list of what closing a connection loses into one phrase. {first} and {second} are fragments such as "the open transaction will be rolled back".

data.name: Shell_LossesThree
data.comment: Joins three items of the list of what closing a connection loses into one phrase. Each is a fragment such as "the open transaction will be rolled back".

data.name: Shell_LossesSentence
data.comment: Ends the list of what closing a connection loses as a sentence. {losses} is the joined phrase; the app capitalizes its first letter.

data.name: Shell_RestoreNeedsConnection
data.value: 还原需要 pg_restore 可以使用的连接，而此窗口没有。
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: Restore Backup was used in a window with no connection profile. pg_restore is PostgreSQL's program and keeps its name.

data.name: Shell_RestoreReadOnly
data.value: 此连接为只读，无法还原备份。请使用可写入的配置连接。
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: Restore Backup was used on a read-only connection.

data.name: Shell_BackupNeedsConnection
data.value: 备份需要 pg_dump 可以使用的连接，而此窗口没有。
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: Back Up Database was used in a window with no connection profile. pg_dump is PostgreSQL's program and keeps its name.

data.name: Shell_ReadOnlySessionHint
data.value: 连接为只读，服务器会拒绝写入。
data.comment: The reason a connection cannot write, shown after "Read-only: " in a tooltip and as the reason a grid cannot be edited. A sentence fragment starting in lowercase.

data.name: Shell_ProductionLockedHint
data.value: 这是生产连接，在你允许之前，此窗口禁止写入。
data.comment: The reason a production connection cannot write yet, shown in tooltips after "Read-only: " or "Results are read-only: ". A sentence fragment starting in lowercase.

data.name: Shell_ProductionNotEnforcedHint
data.value: 此生产连接本应禁止写入，但服务器或连接池没有应用该选项，服务器接受写入。pgNimbus 会保持网格只读，但现在只有 pgNimbus 在阻止写入：你运行的 SQL 仍可能更改数据。
data.comment: Tooltip reason of the amber read-only warning on a production connection whose server did not apply the read-only option. A sentence fragment starting in lowercase. pgNimbus is the product name.

data.name: Shell_ReadOnlyNotEnforcedHint
data.value: 该配置要求只读连接，但服务器或连接池没有应用该选项，服务器接受写入。pgNimbus 会保持网格只读，但现在只有 pgNimbus 在阻止写入：你运行的 SQL 仍可能更改数据。本次会话中请不要依赖此配置的保护。
data.comment: Tooltip reason of the amber read-only warning on a connection profile marked read-only whose server did not apply the option. A sentence fragment starting in lowercase. pgNimbus is the product name.

data.name: Shell_ReadOnlyNotApplied_Status
data.value: 只读未生效：服务器或连接池忽略了配置中的只读选项。网格保持只读，但你运行的 SQL 可以写入。
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: the connection should be read-only but the server accepts writes.

data.name: Shell_StandbyHint
data.value: 服务器是备用副本，会拒绝写入。
data.comment: The reason a connection cannot write, shown after "Read-only: " in a tooltip. A sentence fragment starting in lowercase. A standby replica is a read-only copy of a PostgreSQL server.

data.name: Shell_WritesToggleOn
data.value: 生产环境：此窗口已允许写入。单击可关闭。
data.comment: Tooltip of the production switch in the title bar while writes are allowed.

data.name: Shell_WritesToggleOff
data.value: 生产环境：此窗口禁止写入，服务器会拒绝写入。单击可为此窗口允许写入。
data.comment: Tooltip of the production switch in the title bar while writes are off.

data.name: Shell_ProductionProfileReadOnly
data.value: 此生产配置为只读，其窗口无法允许写入。请在配置中关闭“只读会话”。
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: the production switch was used on a production profile that is read-only. "Read-only session" is the name of an option in the connection dialog.

data.name: Shell_OnlyProductionToggles
data.value: 只有生产配置的窗口才能开启和关闭写入。
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: a command for the production write switch was used in a window that is not a production window.

data.name: Shell_WritesAllowedStatus
data.value: 此窗口已允许写入。使用此配置的其他窗口仍禁止写入。
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: writes were allowed in this production window.

data.name: Shell_CommitFirst
data.value: 请先提交或回滚打开的事务：它持有一个可写入的连接。
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: writes cannot be turned off while a transaction is open.

data.name: Shell_WritesOffAgain
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: writes were turned off again in this production window.

data.name: Shell_SignalsLockedHint
data.value: 此生产窗口禁止写入，因此不会取消或终止其他会话。请先允许写入。
data.comment: Server Activity window: tooltip explaining why the Cancel query and Terminate buttons are disabled in a production window while writes are off.

data.name: Shell_WordWrapOn
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: word wrap in the SQL editor was switched on.

data.name: Shell_WordWrapOff
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: word wrap in the SQL editor was switched off.

data.name: Shell_ImportedPlanUnreadable
data.value: 无法重新读取导入的计划。请用“导入查询计划…”再次导入。
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: a tab holding an imported query plan could not restore its plan after the app restarted. "Import query plan…" is the name of a command.

data.name: Shell_CompletionCatalogStale
data.value: 自动补全沿用了之前的目录：刷新失败（{error}）
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: reloading the names for autocomplete failed. {error} is the error text.

data.name: Shell_TransactionStarted
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: a transaction was started. BEGIN is the SQL command and stays.

data.name: Shell_TransactionBeginFailed
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: starting a transaction failed. {error} is the error text.

data.name: Shell_TransactionCommitted
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: the transaction was committed. COMMIT is the SQL command and stays.

data.name: Shell_TransactionCommitFailed
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: committing the transaction failed. {error} is the error text.

data.name: Shell_TransactionRolledBack
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: the transaction was rolled back. ROLLBACK is the SQL command and stays.

data.name: Shell_TransactionRollbackFailed
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: rolling back the transaction failed. {error} is the error text.

data.name: Shell_TabSourceTitle
data.comment: Name of the tab that shows the CREATE statement of a table or function. {name} is the table or function name, such as orders. Keep the dot.

data.name: Shell_TabNewTableTitle
data.comment: Name of the tab that holds a CREATE TABLE template for a schema. {schema} is the schema name, such as public. Keep the dot.

data.name: Shell_ImportedPlanTitle
data.comment: Name of the tab that shows a query plan imported from pasted text.

data.name: Shell_SelectTableFirst
data.value: 请先在模式树中选择一个表，或先浏览一个表。
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: a table command (analyze, vacuum, truncate, rename, drop) was used with no table selected.

data.name: Shell_MaintVerb_Analyze
data.comment: The verb "analyze" (lowercase, the base form) used inside the messages "Can't analyze …" and "Couldn't analyze …" about the ANALYZE command on a table.

data.name: Shell_MaintVerb_Vacuum
data.comment: The verb "vacuum" (lowercase, the base form) used inside the messages "Can't vacuum …" and "Couldn't vacuum …" about the VACUUM command on a table.

data.name: Shell_MaintVerb_Truncate
data.comment: The verb "truncate" (lowercase, the base form) used inside the messages "Can't truncate …" and "Couldn't truncate …" about emptying a table.

data.name: Shell_MaintVerb_Rename
data.comment: The verb "rename" (lowercase, the base form) used inside the messages "Can't rename …" and "Couldn't rename …" about renaming a table.

data.name: Shell_MaintVerb_Drop
data.comment: The verb "drop" (lowercase, the base form) used inside the messages "Can't drop …" and "Couldn't drop …" about deleting a table.

data.name: Shell_MaintCantApply
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: a table command does not apply to this kind of object. {verb} is the verb, such as truncate; {table} is schema.name; {noun} is view or materialized view.

data.name: Shell_MaintCantReason
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: a table command was refused. {verb} is the verb, such as drop; {table} is schema.name; {reason} is a sentence that says why, such as "the connection is read-only, so the server refuses writes."

data.name: Shell_InDatabase
data.comment: Fragment placed inside the Truncate and Drop confirmations, after the table name, with a leading space: " in database "shop"". {database} is the database name.

data.name: Shell_TruncateEffectPartitioned
data.value: 其中及其所有分区中的每一行都会被删除
data.comment: Part of the Truncate confirmation, for a partitioned table. A sentence without its final period; the confirmation continues with ", and this can't be undone."

data.name: Shell_TruncateEffect
data.value: 其中的每一行都会被删除
data.comment: Part of the Truncate confirmation, for an ordinary table. A sentence without its final period; the confirmation continues with ", and this can't be undone."

data.name: Shell_TruncateConfirm
data.value: 清空表“{table}”{database}？{effect}，且此操作无法撤销。如果其他表的外键引用了它，操作会失败。
data.comment: Confirmation of Truncate in a table's Maintenance menu. {table} is schema.name; {database} is the fragment " in database "shop"" (or empty); {effect} is a phrase such as "Every row in it is deleted".

data.name: Shell_TruncateButton
data.comment: Confirmation of Truncate: the red button that empties the table.

data.name: Shell_DropEffectView
data.comment: Part of the Drop confirmation, for a view. A sentence without its final period; the confirmation continues with ", and this can't be undone."

data.name: Shell_DropEffectMaterializedView
data.value: 该物化视图及其数据会被移除
data.comment: Part of the Drop confirmation, for a materialized view. A sentence without its final period.

data.name: Shell_DropEffectPartitioned
data.value: 该表及其所有分区，连同其中的每一行，都会被移除
data.comment: Part of the Drop confirmation, for a partitioned table. A sentence without its final period.

data.name: Shell_DropEffectTable
data.value: 该表及其中的每一行都会被移除
data.comment: Part of the Drop confirmation, for an ordinary table. A sentence without its final period.

data.name: Shell_DropConfirm
data.value: 删除{noun}“{table}”{database}？{effect}，且此操作无法撤销。如果有视图或其他表的外键依赖它，操作会失败。
data.comment: Confirmation of Drop in a table's Maintenance menu. {noun} is table, view or materialized view; {table} is schema.name; {database} is the fragment " in database "shop"" (or empty); {effect} is a phrase such as "The view is removed".

data.name: Shell_DropButton
data.comment: Confirmation of Drop: the red button that deletes the table or view.

data.name: Shell_RenameHeading
data.comment: Heading of the dialog that asks for a new name. {noun} is table, view or materialized view; {table} is schema.name.

data.name: Shell_MaintRunningAnalyze
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: ANALYZE is running. {table} is schema.name.

data.name: Shell_MaintRunningVacuum
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: VACUUM is running. {table} is schema.name.

data.name: Shell_MaintRunningTruncate
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: a table is being emptied. {table} is schema.name.

data.name: Shell_MaintRunningRename
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: a table is being renamed. {table} is schema.name.

data.name: Shell_MaintRunningDrop
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: a table is being deleted. {table} is schema.name.

data.name: Shell_MaintFailed
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: a table command failed. {verb} is the verb, such as drop; {table} is schema.name; {error} is the server error text.

data.name: Shell_MaintDoneAnalyze
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: ANALYZE finished. {table} is schema.name; {seconds} is the duration, such as 0.4. s means seconds.

data.name: Shell_MaintDoneVacuum
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: VACUUM finished. {table} is schema.name; {seconds} is the duration, such as 0.4. s means seconds.

data.name: Shell_MaintDoneTruncate
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: a table was emptied. {table} is schema.name.

data.name: Shell_MaintDoneRename
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: a table was renamed. {table} is the old schema.name; {newName} is the new schema.name.

data.name: Shell_MaintDoneDrop
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: a table was deleted. {table} is schema.name.

data.name: Shell_SchemaExcluded
data.value: 模式“{schema}”已从自动补全中排除
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: a schema was left out of autocomplete. {schema} is the schema name.

data.name: Shell_SchemaIncluded
data.value: 模式“{schema}”已重新加入自动补全
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: a schema was put back into autocomplete. {schema} is the schema name.

data.name: Shell_ReopenedTab
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: a closed tab was brought back. {title} is its name.

data.name: Shell_ClosedUnsaved_other
data.value: 已关闭 {count} 个含未保存 SQL 的标签页。{how}可重新打开它们（逐个）。
data.comment: Status line at the bottom of the main window: several tabs with unsaved SQL were closed. Plural. {count} is how many, such as 3; {how} is the shortcut that brings them back (such as Ctrl+Shift+T) or the command name "Reopen closed tab".

data.name: Shell_PaletteAction
data.comment: Command palette: grey category label at the right end of a row that runs a command.

data.name: Shell_PaletteSavedQuery
data.comment: Command palette: grey category label at the right end of a row that opens a saved query.

data.name: Shell_PaletteRecentFile
data.comment: Command palette: grey category label at the right end of a row that opens a recently used .sql file.

data.name: Shell_PaletteTable
data.comment: Command palette: grey category label at the right end of a row that opens a table (also used for views).

data.name: Shell_SearchMatchCaseLabel
data.comment: Find bar of the SQL editor (also of the cell inspector), top right of the editor: the short label on the Match case toggle: the same letter in upper and lower case. Adapt to the script of the language if "Aa" means nothing there.

data.name: Shell_SearchWholeWordsLabel
data.comment: Find bar of the SQL editor (also of the cell inspector), top right of the editor: the short label on the Whole words toggle, drawn underlined: a word. Adapt to the script of the language if "ab" means nothing there.

data.name: Sidebar_NewTable
data.comment: Sidebar tree, right-click menu of a schema: opens a CREATE TABLE template in a new tab.

data.name: Sidebar_CopyName
data.comment: Sidebar tree, right-click menu item of a schema, table or role: copies its name to the clipboard.

data.name: Sidebar_BackUpSchema
data.comment: Sidebar tree, right-click menu of a schema: opens the backup window for this schema.

data.name: Sidebar_ExcludeFromAutocomplete
data.comment: Sidebar tree, right-click menu of a schema: a check item; when checked the schema is left out of editor completion.

data.name: Sidebar_ExcludeFromAutocompleteTip
data.value: 不在编辑器补全中提供此模式的表、列和函数。它仍保留在树中。
data.comment: Tooltip of the menu item "Exclude from Autocomplete" in a schema's right-click menu.

data.name: Sidebar_ExcludedFromAutocompleteTip
data.comment: Sidebar tree, tooltip of the small crossed-eye icon beside a schema that is left out of editor completion.

data.name: Sidebar_DropSchema
data.comment: Sidebar tree, right-click menu of a schema: drops the schema after a confirmation; it fails if the schema holds objects.

data.name: Sidebar_DropSchemaCascade
data.comment: Sidebar tree, right-click menu of a schema: drops the schema and everything in it after a confirmation.

data.name: Sidebar_BrowseRows
data.comment: Sidebar tree, right-click menu of a table, view or materialized view: opens the rows of the relation in a new tab (what a double-click does).

data.name: Sidebar_SourceDdl
data.comment: Sidebar tree, right-click menu item of a table, function, index or trigger: opens its CREATE statement in a new tab. DDL means data definition language (the CREATE statement).

data.name: Sidebar_AlterTable
data.comment: Sidebar tree, right-click menu of a table, view or materialized view: opens the dialog that adds and drops columns.

data.name: Sidebar_BackUpTable
data.comment: Sidebar tree, right-click menu of a table, view or materialized view: opens the backup window for this table.

data.name: Sidebar_Maintenance
data.comment: Sidebar tree, right-click menu of a table, view or materialized view: submenu holding Analyze, Vacuum, Truncate, Rename and Drop.

data.name: Sidebar_Analyze
data.comment: Sidebar tree, Maintenance submenu: runs ANALYZE (refreshes the planner's statistics) on the relation. Analyze is the PostgreSQL command name.

data.name: Sidebar_Vacuum
data.comment: Sidebar tree, Maintenance submenu: runs VACUUM (reclaims space) on the relation. Vacuum is the PostgreSQL command name.

data.name: Sidebar_Truncate
data.comment: Sidebar tree, Maintenance submenu: removes every row of the table after a confirmation. Truncate is the PostgreSQL command name.

data.name: Sidebar_RenameItem
data.comment: Menu item that asks for a new name: a relation in the sidebar tree (Maintenance submenu) or a saved query in the saved queries list.

data.name: Sidebar_DropItem
data.comment: Sidebar tree menu item that drops a relation (Maintenance submenu) or an extension after a confirmation.

data.name: Sidebar_InstallExtension
data.comment: Sidebar tree, right-click menu of an extension that is not installed: installs it in the database after a confirmation.

data.name: Sidebar_RolesAndPermissions
data.comment: Sidebar tree, right-click menu of the Roles group or of one role: opens the roles and permissions window.

data.name: Sidebar_Superuser
data.comment: Sidebar tree, tooltip of the key icon beside a role that is a PostgreSQL superuser.

data.name: Sidebar_Loading
data.comment: Sidebar tree: italic placeholder row shown under a node while its children load.

data.name: Sidebar_ErrorRetryTip
data.value: 折叠后再展开即可重试
data.comment: Sidebar tree, tooltip of a red error row that replaced a node's children after loading failed.

data.name: Sidebar_ReloadTip
data.value: 从服务器重新加载树、自动补全和命令面板
data.comment: Sidebar, tooltip of the refresh button beside the filter box. The keyboard shortcut is appended by the app.

data.name: Sidebar_TreeOptions
data.comment: Sidebar, tooltip of the button beside the filter box that opens the tree's options menu.

data.name: Sidebar_ShowAdvancedObjects
data.comment: Sidebar tree options menu: a check item that also shows functions, sequences, types, indexes, triggers and extensions.

data.name: Sidebar_ShowAdvancedObjectsTip
data.value: 同时显示函数、序列、类型、索引、触发器和扩展
data.comment: Tooltip of the menu item "Show Advanced Objects".

data.name: Sidebar_ExpandAllSchemas
data.comment: Sidebar tree options menu: opens every schema one level deep.

data.name: Sidebar_CollapseAll
data.comment: Sidebar tree options menu: closes every node of the tree.

data.name: Sidebar_FilterPlaceholder
data.comment: Sidebar, placeholder text of the filter box above the schema tree.

data.name: Sidebar_ClearFilter
data.comment: Sidebar, tooltip of the small x button inside the schema filter box.

data.name: Sidebar_LoadingSchema
data.comment: Sidebar tree: centred status text while the schema list loads for the first time.

data.name: Sidebar_NoMatches
data.comment: Sidebar tree: shown in the empty panel when the filter box text matches nothing. {filter} is what was typed, such as orders.

data.name: Sidebar_Functions
data.comment: Sidebar tree: name of a group node holding a schema's functions and procedures.

data.name: Sidebar_Sequences
data.comment: Sidebar tree: name of a group node holding a schema's sequences.

data.name: Sidebar_Types
data.comment: Sidebar tree: name of a group node holding a schema's user-defined types (enums, composites, domains).

data.name: Sidebar_Indexes
data.comment: Sidebar tree: name of a group node holding a table's indexes.

data.name: Sidebar_Triggers
data.comment: Sidebar tree: name of a group node holding a table's triggers.

data.name: Sidebar_Roles
data.comment: Sidebar tree: name of a group node holding the server's roles.

data.name: Sidebar_Extensions
data.comment: Sidebar tree: name of a group node holding the server's extensions.

data.name: Sidebar_NoSequences
data.comment: Sidebar tree: grey italic row shown inside an expanded group that has nothing in it: no sequences.

data.name: Sidebar_NoUserTypes
data.comment: Sidebar tree: grey italic row shown inside an expanded group that has nothing in it: no user-defined types.

data.name: Sidebar_NoIndexes
data.comment: Sidebar tree: grey italic row shown inside an expanded group that has nothing in it: no indexes.

data.name: Sidebar_NoTriggers
data.comment: Sidebar tree: grey italic row shown inside an expanded group that has nothing in it: no triggers.

data.name: Sidebar_FunctionProcedure
data.comment: Sidebar tree, dim tag after a function's return type: the routine is a procedure.

data.name: Sidebar_FunctionAggregate
data.comment: Sidebar tree, dim tag after a function's return type: the routine is an aggregate function.

data.name: Sidebar_FunctionWindow
data.comment: Sidebar tree, dim tag after a function's return type: the routine is a window function.

data.name: Sidebar_ExtensionAvailable
data.comment: Sidebar tree, dim text after an extension that is not installed. {version} is the version that would be installed, such as 1.4.

data.name: Sidebar_SequenceDetailAt
data.comment: Sidebar tree, dim text after a sequence that has been used. {type} is its value type, such as bigint; {value} is its current value, such as 42.

data.name: Sidebar_SequenceIncrement
data.comment: Sidebar tree, one line of a sequence's tooltip. {value} is the step, such as 1.

data.name: Sidebar_SequenceCurrent
data.comment: Sidebar tree, one line of a sequence's tooltip. {value} is the last value handed out, such as 42.

data.name: Sidebar_SequenceNotUsed
data.comment: Sidebar tree, one line of a sequence's tooltip: the sequence has not handed out a value yet.

data.name: Sidebar_SequenceRange
data.comment: Sidebar tree, one line of a sequence's tooltip. {min} and {max} are its smallest and largest value, such as 1 and 9223372036854775807.

data.name: Sidebar_SequenceCycles
data.comment: Sidebar tree, last line of a sequence's tooltip: it starts over after reaching its limit.

data.name: Sidebar_EnumDetail_other
data.comment: Sidebar tree, dim text after a user-defined type: an enum with several labels. {count} is how many, such as 5.

data.name: Sidebar_CompositeDetail_other
data.comment: Sidebar tree, dim text after a user-defined type: a composite type with several fields. {count} is how many, such as 3.

data.name: Sidebar_DomainDetail
data.comment: Sidebar tree, dim text after a user-defined type: a domain. {baseType} is the type it is built on, such as text.

data.name: Sidebar_DomainDetailNotNull
data.comment: Sidebar tree, dim text after a user-defined type: a domain that refuses NULL. {baseType} is the type it is built on, such as text. Keep NOT NULL as written (SQL).

data.name: Sidebar_DomainTip
data.comment: Sidebar tree, tooltip of a domain type. {baseType} is the type it is built on, such as text.

data.name: Sidebar_DomainTipNotNull
data.comment: Sidebar tree, tooltip of a domain type that refuses NULL. {baseType} is the type it is built on, such as text. Keep NOT NULL as written (SQL).

data.name: Sidebar_PrimaryKey
data.comment: Sidebar tree, dim tag after an index name: the index backs the table's primary key.

data.name: Sidebar_Unique
data.comment: Sidebar tree, dim tag after an index name: the index enforces uniqueness.

data.name: Sidebar_Disabled
data.comment: Sidebar tree, dim tag after a trigger name: the trigger does not fire.

data.name: Sidebar_SourceTitle
data.comment: Title of the editor tab that shows an index's or trigger's definition. {name} is the object's name, such as orders_pkey.

data.name: Sidebar_DropButton
data.comment: Sidebar: the confirm button of the dialogs that drop a schema or an extension. Drop is the SQL verb and the action is destructive.

data.name: Sidebar_InstallButton
data.comment: Sidebar: the confirm button of the dialog that installs an extension.

data.name: Sidebar_DropSchemaConfirm
data.value: 删除模式“{schema}”？如果模式中仍有对象，操作会失败。
data.comment: Confirmation dialog for the plain Drop Schema action. {schema} is the schema name, such as sales.

data.name: Sidebar_DropSchemaCascadeConfirm
data.value: 删除模式“{schema}”及其中的所有内容？其中的表、视图及其数据都会被移除。
data.comment: Confirmation dialog for Drop Schema (Cascade). {schema} is the schema name, such as sales.

data.name: Sidebar_InstallExtensionConfirm
data.value: 在数据库“{database}”中安装扩展“{extension}”？这会直接对其执行。
data.comment: Confirmation dialog before installing an extension. {extension} is its name, such as pg_trgm; {database} is the connected database name, such as shop.

data.name: Sidebar_InstallExtensionConfirmNoDb
data.value: 安装扩展“{extension}”？这会对当前连接的数据库执行。
data.comment: Confirmation dialog before installing an extension when the database name is not known. {extension} is its name, such as pg_trgm.

data.name: Sidebar_DropExtensionConfirm
data.value: 删除扩展“{extension}”？它提供的对象将被移除。
data.comment: Confirmation dialog before dropping an extension. {extension} is its name, such as pg_trgm.

data.name: Sidebar_SavedQueriesHeading
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab: heading of the saved queries list (shown in capitals in English).

data.name: Sidebar_OpenInNewTab
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab: right-click menu item of a saved query or a history entry: opens its SQL in a new editor tab.

data.name: Sidebar_SavedQueriesEmpty
data.value: 还没有保存的内容。右键单击查询标签页并选择“保存查询”，或按保存快捷键。
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab: hint shown instead of the saved queries list when it is empty.

data.name: Sidebar_HistoryHeading
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab: heading of the run history list (shown in capitals in English).

data.name: Sidebar_HistoryScopeTip
data.value: 仅显示针对当前连接运行的查询
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab: tooltip of the toggle button beside the history search box.

data.name: Sidebar_HistorySearchPlaceholder
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab: placeholder text of the history search box.

data.name: Sidebar_ClearSearch
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab: tooltip of the small x button inside the history search box.

data.name: Sidebar_HistoryOffHint
data.value: 历史记录已关闭，因此你运行的查询不会被记录。请在“设置”中开启。
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab: hint above the history list when recording of history is switched off. Settings is the name of the settings page.

data.name: Sidebar_PinTip
data.value: 固定此条目，使其保持在顶部，并在“清除历史”后仍然保留
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab: tooltip of the pin button on a history entry. Clear History is the name of a menu item.

data.name: Sidebar_CopySql
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab: right-click menu item of a history entry: copies its SQL text.

data.name: Sidebar_Pin
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab: right-click menu item of a history entry that is not pinned.

data.name: Sidebar_Unpin
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab: right-click menu item of a history entry that is pinned.

data.name: Sidebar_ClearHistory
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab: right-click menu item that removes every history entry that is not pinned.

data.name: Sidebar_ClearHistoryTip
data.value: 移除所有未固定的条目
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab: tooltip of the menu item Clear History.

data.name: Sidebar_HistoryEmpty
data.value: 你运行的查询会显示在这里
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab: hint shown instead of the history list when it is empty.

data.name: Sidebar_HistoryNoMatches
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab: hint shown when the history search matches no entry.

data.name: Sidebar_RenameSavedQueryTitle
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab: title of the naming dialog opened by Rename… on a saved query.

data.name: Sidebar_History_YesterdayAt
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab, a history row: when the statement ran, yesterday. {time} is a 24-hour clock time, such as 09:41.

data.name: Sidebar_History_WeekdayAt
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab, a history row: when the statement ran, within the last week. {weekday} is the short weekday name (the Sidebar_Weekday_ entries); {time} is a 24-hour clock time, such as 09:41.

data.name: Sidebar_History_MonthDay
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab, a history row: when the statement ran earlier this year. {month} is the short month name (the Sidebar_Month_ entries); {day} is the day of the month, such as 18.

data.name: Sidebar_History_Ran
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab, a history row: tooltip with the full time. {at} is a date and time, such as 2026-07-18 09:41:00.

data.name: Sidebar_History_RanOn
data.comment: Sidebar, Queries tab, a history row: tooltip with the full time and the connection. {at} is a date and time, such as 2026-07-18 09:41:00; {connection} is the connection's name, such as prod/shop.

data.name: Sidebar_Weekday_Mon
data.comment: Short name of a weekday (three letters in English), used in a history row's time.

data.comment: Short name of a weekday (three letters in English), used in a history row's time.

data.name: Sidebar_Weekday_Wed
data.comment: Short name of a weekday (three letters in English), used in a history row's time.

data.name: Sidebar_Weekday_Thu
data.comment: Short name of a weekday (three letters in English), used in a history row's time.

data.name: Sidebar_Weekday_Fri
data.comment: Short name of a weekday (three letters in English), used in a history row's time.

data.name: Sidebar_Weekday_Sat
data.comment: Short name of a weekday (three letters in English), used in a history row's time.

data.name: Sidebar_Weekday_Sun
data.comment: Short name of a weekday (three letters in English), used in a history row's time.

data.name: Sidebar_Month_Jan
data.comment: Short name of a month (three letters in English), used in a history row's date.

data.name: Sidebar_Month_Feb
data.comment: Short name of a month (three letters in English), used in a history row's date.

data.name: Sidebar_Month_Mar
data.comment: Short name of a month (three letters in English), used in a history row's date.

data.name: Sidebar_Month_Apr
data.comment: Short name of a month (three letters in English), used in a history row's date.

data.name: Sidebar_Month_May

data.name: Editor_AddRowInsert
data.comment: Add-row dialog: primary button that inserts the row at once.

data.name: Editor_AddRowLoadFailed
data.comment: Add-row dialog status line. {message} is the error text.

data.name: Editor_AddRowStaged
data.value: 行已暂存，请在状态栏中提交或放弃。
data.comment: Add-row dialog status line after the row was staged.

data.name: Editor_AddRowInserted
data.comment: Add-row dialog status line after a successful insert.

data.name: Editor_AddRowOutcomeUnknown
data.value: 行发送后连接丢失，因此它可能已插入，也可能没有。再次添加之前，请先检查该表。

data.name: Editor_AddRowFailed
data.comment: Add-row dialog status line. {message} is the error text.

data.name: Results_JsonObjectSummary_other
data.comment: Cell inspector, JSON tree and folded JSON text: an object folded to one line. {count} is how many members it has. Keep the braces around it: they are JSON's object brackets.

data.name: Results_JsonArraySummary_other
data.comment: Cell inspector, JSON tree and folded JSON text: an array folded to one line. {count} is how many elements it has. Keep the square brackets around it.

data.name: Results_StaleFiltersTip
data.value: 查询已被编辑：请运行它以更新筛选。
data.comment: Results area: tooltip over the dimmed browse filter chips after the page query was edited by hand.

data.name: Results_CopyAsMenu
data.comment: Results grid context menu: submenu heading for copying the selection in another format.

data.name: Results_FormatCsv
data.comment: Format name (comma-separated values) in the grid's Copy As submenu and in file save dialogs. Usually left as is.

data.name: Results_FormatJson
data.comment: Format name (JSON) in the grid's Copy As submenu and in file save dialogs. Usually left as is.

data.name: Results_CopyAsMarkdown
data.comment: Results grid context menu, Copy As submenu: copies the selection as a Markdown table.

data.name: Results_CopyAsInsert
data.comment: Results grid context menu, Copy As submenu: copies the selection as SQL INSERT statements. INSERT is an SQL keyword.

data.name: Results_InspectCell
data.comment: Results grid context menu: opens the cell inspector on the cell.

data.name: Results_RowDetails
data.comment: Results grid context menu: opens the row as a form.

data.name: Results_FilterMenu
data.comment: Results grid context menu (browse mode): submenu of filters made from the clicked cell.

data.name: Results_SetCellNull
data.comment: Results grid context menu: sets the cell's value to NULL. NULL is the SQL keyword.

data.name: Results_FollowForeignKey
data.comment: Results grid context menu: placeholder text of the item that jumps to the referenced row. It is replaced with the specific text when the menu opens.

data.name: Results_ReferencingRows
data.comment: Results grid context menu: submenu listing tables that have rows pointing at this row.

data.name: Results_AddRow
data.comment: Results grid context menu: opens the dialog that inserts a new row.

data.name: Results_DeleteSelectedRows
data.comment: Results grid context menu: deletes the selected rows.

data.name: Results_NoResultsYet
data.comment: Results area: heading of the empty state before any query has run.

data.name: Results_NoRowsMatch
data.comment: Results area: heading of the empty state when browse filters match no rows.

data.name: Results_ClearConditions
data.comment: Results area: button in the no-match empty state that removes all filters.

data.name: Results_RunHintNone
data.comment: Results area: hint under 'No results yet' when no keyboard gesture is known.

data.name: Results_RunHintOne
data.comment: Results area: hint under 'No results yet'. {gesture} is a keyboard shortcut, such as Ctrl+Enter.

data.name: Results_RunHintTwo
data.value: 按 {first} 或 {second} 运行查询
data.comment: Results area: hint under 'No results yet'. {first} and {second} are keyboard shortcuts, such as Ctrl+Enter and F5.

data.name: Results_PlanColor
data.comment: Query plan header (tree view): label before the buttons that choose what the heat bars show.

data.name: Results_PlanMetricTime
data.comment: Query plan header: button that colors the tree's bars by execution time.

data.name: Results_PlanMetricRows
data.comment: Query plan header: button that colors the tree's bars by row count.

data.name: Results_PlanMetricCost
data.comment: Query plan header: button that colors the tree's bars by planner cost.

data.name: Results_PlanMetricBuffers
data.comment: Query plan header: button that colors the tree's bars by buffer (block) usage.

data.name: Results_PlanCompare
data.comment: Query plan header: button that opens a menu to save the plan or compare it with a saved one. Keep the ▾ arrow.

data.name: Results_PlanCompareTip
data.value: 将此计划保存到 Query Lab，或与已保存的计划对比
data.comment: Query plan header: tooltip of the Compare button. Query Lab is a feature name.

data.name: Results_PlanSaveToLab
data.comment: Query plan header, Compare menu: saves the plan in Query Lab.

data.name: Results_PlanCompareWith
data.comment: Query plan header, Compare menu: submenu listing saved plans to compare with.

data.name: Results_PlanOpenLab
data.comment: Query plan header, Compare menu: opens the Query Lab window.

data.name: Results_PlanExport
data.comment: Query plan header: button that opens a menu to copy or save the plan. Keep the ▾ arrow.

data.name: Results_PlanExportTip
data.comment: Query plan header: tooltip of the Export button.

data.name: Results_PlanCopyJson
data.comment: Query plan header, Export menu: copies the plan as JSON.

data.name: Results_PlanCopyText
data.comment: Query plan header, Export menu: copies the plan as text.

data.name: Results_PlanSaveJson
data.comment: Query plan header, Export menu: saves the plan to a .json file. Keep the extension.

data.name: Results_PlanSaveText
data.comment: Query plan header, Export menu: saves the plan to a .txt file. Keep the extension.

data.name: Results_PlanViewText
data.comment: Query plan header: button that shows the plan as text.

data.name: Results_PlanViewTree
data.comment: Query plan header: button that shows the plan as a tree.

data.name: Results_PlanCloseTip
data.comment: Query plan header: tooltip of the ✕ button.

data.name: Results_InspectorView
data.comment: Cell inspector: button that shows the value read-only (the other half of View / Edit).

data.name: Results_InspectorEdit
data.comment: Cell inspector: button that switches to editing the value.

data.name: Results_InspectorTree
data.comment: Cell inspector: toggle button that shows a JSON value as a tree.

data.name: Results_InspectorTreeTip
data.value: 切换树形 / 文本视图
data.comment: Cell inspector: tooltip of the Tree toggle.

data.name: Results_InspectorWrap
data.comment: Cell inspector: toggle button for word wrap.

data.name: Results_InspectorWrapTip
data.comment: Cell inspector: tooltip of the Wrap toggle.

data.name: Results_InspectorFormat
data.comment: Cell inspector (editing JSON): button that pretty-prints the text.

data.name: Results_InspectorFormatTip
data.comment: Cell inspector: tooltip of the Format button.

data.name: Results_InspectorMinify
data.comment: Cell inspector (editing JSON): button that collapses the text to one line.

data.name: Results_InspectorMinifyTip
data.comment: Cell inspector: tooltip of the Minify button.

data.name: Results_FilterIsTrue
data.comment: Results grid context menu, Filter submenu: keep rows where a boolean column is true. {column} is a column name, such as active.

data.name: Results_FilterIsFalse
data.comment: Results grid context menu, Filter submenu: keep rows where a boolean column is false. {column} is a column name, such as active.

data.name: Results_FilterEquals
data.comment: Results grid context menu, Filter submenu: keep rows equal to the clicked cell. {column} is a column name, {value} the cell's text (shortened), such as status = open.

data.name: Results_FilterNotEquals
data.comment: Results grid context menu, Filter submenu: keep rows different from the clicked cell. {column} is a column name, {value} the cell's text (shortened).

data.name: Results_FilterContains
data.comment: Results grid context menu, Filter submenu: keep rows whose text contains the clicked cell's value. {column} is a column name, {value} the cell's text (shortened).

data.name: Results_FilterIsNull
data.comment: Results grid context menu, Filter submenu: keep rows where the column is NULL. {column} is a column name.

data.name: Results_FilterIsNotNull
data.comment: Results grid context menu, Filter submenu: keep rows where the column is not NULL. {column} is a column name.

data.name: Results_FollowFk
data.comment: Results grid context menu: jumps to the row a foreign key points at. {column} is the clicked column, {target} the referenced table, such as public.customers.

data.name: Results_CantFollowColumn
data.value: 无法跟随：列 {column} 不在此结果集中。
data.comment: Status line: following a foreign key failed because a key column is not in the result. {column} is a column name.

data.name: Results_CantFollowNull
data.value: 无法跟随 NULL 键，它不引用任何行。
data.comment: Status line: the clicked foreign key cell is NULL, so there is no row to jump to.

data.name: Results_DiscardInspectorEdit
data.comment: Confirm dialog: shown when closing the cell inspector with an unsaved edit. {column} is a column name.

data.name: Results_DeleteRowsConfirm_other
data.value: 删除这 {number} 行？此操作无法撤销。
data.comment: Confirm dialog: deleting several rows from the grid. {number} is how many, such as 12.

data.name: Results_ImportTitle
data.comment: Title of the file picker for importing a file into a table.

data.name: Results_ImportFileType
data.comment: File type filter in the import file picker.

data.name: Results_AllFiles
data.comment: File type filter in a file picker: every file.

data.name: Results_FileTypeText
data.comment: File type name in the save dialog for a plan saved as .txt.

data.name: Results_ImportReading
data.comment: Status line while an import file is read. {file} is a file name, such as data.csv.

data.name: Results_ImportNothing
data.value: 没有可导入的内容：文件中没有行。
data.comment: Status line: the import file was empty.

data.name: Results_ImportFailed
data.comment: Status line: importing failed. {message} is the reason.

data.name: Results_Imported_other
data.comment: Status line after an import, plural. {number} is how many rows, such as 1,200; {table} is schema.table.

data.name: Results_ExportFailed
data.comment: Status line: writing an export file failed. {message} is the reason.

data.name: Results_NoSavedPlans
data.comment: Query plan header, Compare With submenu: shown when Query Lab holds no saved plan.

data.name: Results_MoreInQueryLab
data.value: 在 Query Lab 中查看更多…
data.comment: Query plan header, Compare With submenu: opens Query Lab. Query Lab is a feature name.

data.name: Results_PlanCopied
data.comment: Status line after copying a query plan.

data.name: Results_SavePlanTitle
data.comment: Title of the save dialog for a query plan.

data.name: Results_PlanSaved
data.comment: Status line after saving a query plan. {file} is a file name, such as plan.json.

data.name: Results_SaveFailed
data.comment: Status line: saving a plan file failed. {message} is the reason.

data.name: Results_HeaderPrimaryKey
data.comment: Tooltip of a results column header: the column is part of the primary key.

data.name: Results_HeaderNotNull
data.comment: Tooltip of a results column header: the column cannot be NULL.

data.name: Results_TimePlaceholder
data.comment: Placeholder of the time box in a grid cell editor for a timestamp: the format to type.

data.name: Results_TabTitle
data.comment: Default name of a query tab when nothing better is known.

data.name: Results_TabTitleNumbered
data.comment: Default name of a new scratch query tab. {number} counts the tabs, such as 3.

data.name: Results_DirtyScratch
data.comment: Tooltip of the dirty dot on a tab that was never saved to a file.

data.name: Results_DirtyFile
data.value: 有未保存的更改：此标签页与磁盘上的文件不同
data.comment: Tooltip of the dirty dot on a tab opened from a file.

data.name: Results_ColumnCap
data.value: 显示 {total} 列中的 {shown} 列
data.comment: Status bar: the grid shows fewer columns than the result has. {shown} and {total} are numbers, such as 300 and 5,000.

data.name: Results_CapRows
data.value: 已限制为 {max} 行，请细化查询以获取完整结果
data.comment: Status bar warning: the result was cut at a row limit. {max} is the limit, such as 100,000.

data.name: Results_CapBytes
data.value: 已限制为 {megabytes} MB 的结果，请细化查询以获取完整结果
data.comment: Status bar warning: the result was cut at a size limit. {megabytes} is a number, such as 256.

data.name: Results_CapScript
data.value: 后续的行未保留：脚本的结果已达到 {max} 行或 {megabytes} MB
data.comment: Status bar warning: a script's results together reached a limit. {max} is a row count, {megabytes} a size in MB.

data.name: Results_OtherTableStatus
data.value: 此查询没有读取 {table}（此标签页浏览的表），因此它作为普通查询运行：没有筛选，也不能编辑。
data.comment: Status line: a browse-shaped query read another table. {table} is schema.table.

data.name: Results_WritesAllowedHint
data.value: 现在已允许写入。请再次运行查询以编辑这些行。
data.comment: Completes the tooltip 'Results are read-only: …' after writes were allowed in a production window.

data.name: Results_OtherTableHint
data.value: 该查询没有读取 {table}（此标签页浏览的表）。请完整写出 {table} 以浏览和编辑它。
data.comment: Completes the tooltip 'Results are read-only: …'. {table} is schema.table, such as public.orders.

data.name: Results_StatusReady
data.comment: Status line of a tab that has not run anything.

data.name: Results_StatusRunning
data.comment: Status line while a query runs. Keep the three dots.

data.name: Results_StatusDone
data.comment: Status line after a query finished.

data.name: Results_StatusCancelled
data.comment: Status line after a query was cancelled.

data.name: Results_StatusError
data.comment: Status line after a failure. {message} is the reason.

data.name: Results_ErrorStatus
data.comment: Status line after a failed statement. {message} is the server's message, {location} is empty or the text '(line 3, column 15)' with a leading space, {note} is empty or the text 'transaction rolled back' with a leading space.

data.name: Results_ErrorLocation
data.comment: Added to an error status line: where in the editor the error is. Keep the leading space. {line} and {column} are numbers.

data.name: Results_ErrorRolledBack
data.comment: Added to an error status line when the statement ran in a transaction that was rolled back. Keep the leading space.

data.name: Results_TimingFirstByte
data.comment: Status bar timing of a query. {total} is the elapsed milliseconds, {first} the milliseconds until the first row arrived, such as 42 and 7.

data.name: Results_TimingMs
data.comment: Status bar timing: milliseconds. {ms} is a number, such as 42.

data.name: Results_TimingTotal
data.comment: Status bar timing of a whole script, in milliseconds. {ms} is a number, such as 420.

data.name: Results_RowsAffected
data.comment: Status bar: how many rows a command changed. {rows} is a count with its unit, such as 5 rows.

data.name: Results_Rows_other
data.comment: A count of rows, plural. {number} is the count, such as 1,200.

data.name: Results_ScriptOk_other
data.value: 脚本：{count} 条语句执行成功
data.comment: Status line after a script ran without error. {count} is how many statements, such as 12.

data.name: Results_DidYouMean
data.comment: Suggestion under a failed query: a name that differs only in capitals. {replacement} is the fixed name, such as "Spells".

data.name: Results_QuoteIdentifiers
data.value: 为 {number} 个标识符加引号以匹配数据库？
data.comment: Suggestion under a failed query: several names need quotes to match the database. {number} is how many.

data.name: Results_PlanImported
data.comment: Summary of a plan tab opened from pasted text, and its status line.

data.name: Results_PlanSavedSummary
data.comment: Summary of a plan tab opened from Query Lab.

data.name: Results_PlanSavedStatus
data.comment: Status line when a saved plan was opened. {name} is the name the person gave it.

data.name: Results_PlanPlanning
data.comment: Plan header summary: planning time. {ms} is milliseconds with decimals, such as 0.123.

data.name: Results_PlanExecution
data.comment: Plan header summary: execution time. {ms} is milliseconds with decimals, such as 12.345.

data.name: Results_PlanRunWriteTitle
data.value: EXPLAIN ANALYZE 执行了这条写入语句
data.comment: Plan warning title: a hand-written EXPLAIN ANALYZE ran a data-changing statement. EXPLAIN ANALYZE is SQL.

data.name: Results_PlanRunWriteDetail

data.comment: Plan warning detail that goes with 'EXPLAIN ANALYZE executed this write'. Run and Explain are command names.

data.name: Results_PlanRolledBackTitle
data.value: 修改数据的语句已回滚
data.comment: Plan warning title: the analyzed statement changes data but was rolled back.

data.name: Results_PlanRolledBackDetail
data.value: EXPLAIN ANALYZE 在事务内执行了此语句并将其回滚，因此没有任何更改被持久化。
data.comment: Plan warning detail that goes with 'Data-modifying statement rolled back'.

data.name: Results_StatusRunningExplainAnalyze
data.comment: Status line while EXPLAIN ANALYZE runs. Keep the three dots.

data.name: Results_StatusRunningExplain
data.comment: Status line while EXPLAIN runs. Keep the three dots.

data.name: Results_StatusPlanReady
data.comment: Status line after a query plan was produced.

data.name: Results_StatusExplainFailed
data.comment: Status line: EXPLAIN failed. {message} is the reason.

data.name: Results_ElapsedSeconds
data.comment: Elapsed time of a running query in seconds. {seconds} is a number with one decimal, such as 2.5.

data.name: Results_HintScriptReadOnly
data.value: 多语句脚本以只读方式运行，请单独运行语句以进行编辑。

data.name: Results_TheTable
data.comment: Used inside sentences when the table's name is not known, as in 'the table has no primary key'.

data.name: Results_HintNoPrimaryKey
data.value: {table} 没有主键，因此无法精确定位行。
data.comment: Completes the tooltip 'Results are read-only: …'. {table} is schema.table or the words 'the table'.

data.name: Results_HintComputedColumns
data.value: 有些列是表达式或系统列，不是表的列。
data.comment: Completes the tooltip 'Results are read-only: …'.

data.name: Results_HintMultipleTables
data.value: 结果合并了多个表的列。
data.comment: Completes the tooltip 'Results are read-only: …'.

data.name: Results_HintRepeatedColumn
data.comment: Completes the tooltip 'Results are read-only: …'.

data.name: Results_HintNotPlainTable
data.value: 数据源是视图、函数或其他无法按键更新行的对象。

data.name: Results_HintNotMappable

data.value: 主键列 {column}（{type}）的类型 pgNimbus 无法读取，因此无法精确标识行。

data.name: Results_EditUnavailable
data.comment: Status line or message when an edit is tried on read-only results.

data.name: Results_EditPkUnsupported
data.comment: Status line when someone edits a primary key column.

data.name: Results_EditPkMissing

data.name: Results_UpdateFailed

data.name: Results_InvalidValue

data.name: Results_EditPartOfKey
data.value: {column} 是主键的一部分，暂不支持编辑键列。

data.name: Results_PkNotNull

data.name: Results_DeleteUnavailable
data.comment: Status line when delete is tried on read-only results.

data.name: Results_Restaged_other

data.name: Results_StagedDropped_other
data.value: {count} 行暂存的行已丢弃（在别处被删除）

data.name: Results_ReloadedNothing

data.name: Results_StagedLeft_other

data.name: Results_UnstagedConflicts_other
data.value: 已取消暂存 {count} 个冲突行；{left}
data.comment: Status line after unstaging conflicting rows. {count} is how many, {left} is the phrase '3 staged changes left'.

data.name: Results_Discarded_other
data.value: 已放弃 {count} 项暂存的更改
data.comment: Status line after discarding staged changes. {count} is how many.

data.name: Results_CommitFirst
data.value: 请先提交或放弃 {table} 的暂存更改。

data.name: Dialogs_PendingTitle
data.comment: Window title of the dialog that reviews staged changes (safe mode) before they are committed. pgNimbus is the product name.

data.name: Dialogs_PendingHint
data.value: 提交时，这些 SQL 会作为一个事务运行：要么全部生效，要么全部不生效。每个被编辑或删除的行会先被重新读取并加锁：如果自你加载以来另一个会话更改或删除了它，整个提交都会回滚，并向你显示发生了什么变化。值以内联方式显示以供审阅；实际执行使用参数化。
data.comment: Staged changes dialog: explanation under the title of what the commit does.

data.name: Dialogs_DiscardAllButton
data.comment: Staged changes dialog: button that throws away every staged change. The database has not been touched yet.

data.name: Dialogs_CommitChanges_other
data.comment: Staged changes dialog: the button that commits the changes, plural. {count} is how many, such as 3.

data.name: Dialogs_PendingUnchecked

data.comment: Staged changes dialog: warning naming the columns whose values cannot be compared with the server's current ones. {columns} is a comma-separated list of column names, such as shipping_box, notes.

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictTitle
data.comment: Window title of the dialog shown when a staged commit was rolled back because another session changed the rows. pgNimbus is the product name.

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictColumn
data.comment: Commit rolled back dialog: caption of the first column of the table of conflicting values, the column's name.

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictLoaded
data.comment: Commit rolled back dialog: caption of the column that shows the value as it was when the user loaded the row.

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictServer
data.comment: Commit rolled back dialog: caption of the column that shows the value the database holds now.

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictStaged
data.comment: Commit rolled back dialog: caption of the column that shows the value the user staged.

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictNothingCommitted
data.value: 没有提交任何内容。重新暂存会重新加载这些行，并将你的值叠加在当前值之上，供你审阅后再次提交。
data.comment: Commit rolled back dialog: hint beside the buttons.

data.name: Dialogs_UnstageButton
data.comment: Commit rolled back dialog: button that drops the staged changes of the conflicting rows only.

data.name: Dialogs_RestageButton
data.comment: Commit rolled back dialog: button that reloads the conflicting rows and keeps the user's staged values on top.

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictSummaryLocked
data.value: 有暂存的行被另一个会话锁定
data.comment: Commit rolled back dialog: title line when a row is locked by another session.

data.comment: Commit rolled back dialog: title line when no particular row can be named.

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictSummaryRows_other
data.value: {count} 个暂存的行已与服务器不匹配
data.comment: Commit rolled back dialog: title line, plural. {count} is how many rows, such as 3.

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictMore_other
data.value: 另有 {count} 个冲突行未显示。
data.comment: Commit rolled back dialog: note under the list when it is cut, plural. {count} is how many rows are not shown, such as 450.

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictRowHeader
data.comment: Commit rolled back dialog: header of one conflicting row. {key} is its key, such as order_id = 1042, line = 1.

data.comment: Commit rolled back dialog: what happened to one row. Another session deleted it, and the user had staged a delete.

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictDetailDeletedEdit
data.value: 被另一个会话删除（或其键已更改）。你暂存的是编辑。
data.comment: Commit rolled back dialog: what happened to one row. Another session deleted it, and the user had staged an edit.

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictDetailChangedDelete
data.value: 被另一个会话更改。你暂存的是删除。
data.comment: Commit rolled back dialog: what happened to one row. Another session changed it, and the user had staged a delete.

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictDetailChangedEdit
data.value: 被另一个会话更改。你暂存的是编辑。
data.comment: Commit rolled back dialog: what happened to one row. Another session changed it, and the user had staged an edit.

data.comment: Commit rolled back dialog: shown in a value cell when the row no longer exists on the server.

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictDeleteRow
data.comment: Commit rolled back dialog: shown in the "You staged" cell when the user staged a delete of the whole row.

data.comment: Commit rolled back dialog (text under the title) and status line: why the commit was rolled back. {what} is the count part, such as "1 row was changed and 1 row was deleted"; {detail} is one sentence about the first row.

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictChanged_other
data.comment: Part of the rolled-back commit message, plural. {count} is how many rows, such as 3.

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictDeleted_other
data.comment: Part of the rolled-back commit message, plural. {count} is how many rows, such as 3.

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictMessageLocked

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictStagedDelete

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictStagedEdit

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictRowDeleted
data.value: 行 {key} 已不存在：另一个会话删除了它或更改了它的键（{staged}）。
data.comment: One sentence about a conflicting row. {key} is the row's key, such as id = 7; {staged} is what the user had staged, such as "you staged a delete".

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictColumnChange
data.comment: One column that another session changed, in a list separated by semicolons. {column} is the column, {before} and {after} are values, such as status was 'packed', now 'shipped'.

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictRowChanged
data.value: 行 {key} 被另一个会话更改：{changes}（{staged}）。

data.name: Dialogs_ConflictRowChangedMore
data.value: 行 {key} 被另一个会话更改：{changes}；另有 {count} 列（{staged}）。
data.comment: One sentence about a conflicting row where more columns changed than are listed. {key}, {changes} and {staged} as in the sentence without "more"; {count} is how many columns are not listed, such as 2.

data.name: Security_PasswordConfirm
